quests.title: Team trading cards you can tap open
quests.why: Every role as a card with its level, job type and sheet, so the team is easy to meet.

quests.title: Character sheets on the back of each card
quests.why: Each role's record, XP and quests one tap from its card.

quests.title: A Slopworks logo and favicon
quests.why: One mark for the site, the tab and the cards.

quests.title: Holiday avatars for every role
quests.why: Each role dresses up for the season, switched on only after Ryno's yes.

quests.title: A real team calendar with a subscribe feed
quests.why: Runs, reviews and holiday themes by month, and an .ics file to follow them.

quests.title: A light and dark theme switch, no script
quests.why: Visitors pick a theme with a plain checkbox; nothing is sent or stored.

quests.title: Month-1 goals on Metrics
quests.why: Three measurable goals with targets and progress from records.

quests.title: How this works, in plain words
quests.why: The daily run, the roles and where Ryno decides, on one page.

quests.title: Public metrics and trends from records
quests.why: Merge time, CI catches, failures and lessons, every number linked to its record.

quests.title: Decisions paraphrased, never quoted, on the site
quests.why: Ryno's exact words stay in the records; the site says what was decided.

quests.title: Daily, weekly and level-up quests
quests.why: Rewards the work that keeps the site accurate, not activity: Week 2 of the Slopworks RPG.
quests.fog: How reviewer quality grades work without being gamed
quests.reason: Badges and mission rollouts stay HELD (Oct 27 prototype decision). The board tracks it; it is not in progress.

quests.title: Notice a missed run and measure each run
quests.why: A five-day outage left no record. A heartbeat flags a missed run; a usage ledger records each run's model and minutes.

quests.title: A page for every update and issue
quests.why: One shareable page per tracker entry, with its source and who added it: the front door for getting found.

quests.title: This week in Grok Bot, with a shipping calendar
quests.why: The weekly recap gains the week's Grok Bot updates and a day-by-day view of what shipped.

quests.title: A preview image for shared links
quests.why: Links shared elsewhere show a blank card today.

quests.title: Shorter Team and Lessons pages on phones
quests.why: Role and lesson cards open on tap, so phone readers scroll less.

quests.title: Trend lines on Metrics
quests.why: Small static charts next to the numbers, with the values written out.

quests.title: Filter Lessons by type and the Timeline by decision
quests.why: One tap to see only incidents, or only what Ryno decided.

quests.title: The first team raid
quests.why: A hard task several roles take on together, picked from the six raids in the RPG plan.

quests.title: A monthly State of Slopworks page
quests.why: Once a month, what the team shipped, learned and missed, from the records.

quests.title: Impact Ledger and Build Observatory
quests.why: Showcase pages for real measured impact, once four weeks of showcase data exist.

quests.title: A shareable Grok Bot template
quests.why: A routine visitors can copy to follow the tracker in their own Grok Bot.

quests.title: Separate bots for each role
quests.why: Split roles into their own bots once the daily loop is stable, each one earning its place.

quests.title: A bottom tab bar on phones
quests.why: Persistent links to six pages at the bottom of every phone screen.
quests.reason: The four-link top nav stays; a second nav needs evidence that the hubs cost visitors.

quests.title: A dark mode option
quests.why: A static dark theme for readers who prefer it.
quests.reason: It already existed: the site follows the phone's dark setting, with contrast checked in both themes.

oaths.claim: 50 unique repo visitors in GitHub's 14-day window, 5 stars, 2 outside referrer domains
oaths.note: Visitor measurement is on hold, so this may be judged Unjudged.

oaths.claim: 12 real-trace showcase entries, 6 of them new, with at least 1 new format
Every new tracker item logged within 1 day, and 2 features demoed within 7 days of entry

camp.title: A daily run that finishes every day
